description: Deploy a base64-encoded tar.gz or zip archive in one call — no presigned PUT, no curl step. Max 3 MB raw (~4 MB base64). For larger bundles use chaprola_app_deploy.

archive.description: Base64-encoded tar.gz or zip archive of the app directory

archive_format.description: Archive format. Auto-detected from magic bytes if omitted.

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when deploying to a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_app_deploy_inline
